_meta.title: Example contradiction registry
_meta.note: Optional companion to the problem graph. A node's purpose is verifier-backed when a registry entry it links to (node.refs.registry) carries a `verified_by` record. Point TRIZ_REGISTRY at your own file.

contradictions.title: Inspection cost vs. coverage
contradictions.solution_summary: Risk-weighted sampling with automatic escalation on drift
contradictions.expected_benefit: full effective coverage at partial inspection cost
contradictions.actual_benefit: measured: 38% inspection hours, no change in escape rate over 12 weeks

contradictions.title: Rework capacity vs. lead time
contradictions.solution_summary: Local rework cells fed by a shared parts buffer
contradictions.expected_benefit: lead time held while rework stays economic
contradictions.actual_benefit: pilot cell only; line-wide effect not measured
